scope: Construction and certification gates, not a rank predictor or authorization for a compute-heavy campaign.

required_inputs: named generic subgroup and base change
generic mechanism dimension or certified upper bound
exact specialized independence and relation evidence
gates.pass: Report q = k - kernel_dimension modulo the specialized generic rational span.
gates.fail: Capacity below the requested contribution excludes only this mechanism for that contribution.
gates.unknown: An absent independence certificate leaves the rank contribution UNKNOWN.

required_inputs: exact point identities modulo the named generic rational span
gates.pass: Use n - rank_Q(R) as an upper bound, attained only with an independent lower certificate.
gates.fail: Never substitute edge count or F2 signed-graph rank.
gates.unknown: Unverified candidate relations cannot prune a block.

gates.pass: Retain the full degree-2^m carrier or the product curve with its degree-2^(m-1) native lift.
gates.fail: A smaller quotient without its affine lift is insufficient for this marked block.
gates.unknown: Other unmarked sections and non-native constructions remain UNKNOWN.

required_inputs: integral even-degree homogeneous forms retaining nonsquare constants
one primitive nonbranch rational product point
real signs and all collision valuation parities, or exact factorization-free representatives
gates.pass: Exact native square roots at the supplied parameter.
gates.fail: A nonzero native squareclass excludes this lift at this parameter only.
gates.unknown: Local product points, missing primes, branch values, or absent rational product points do not invoke the criterion.

required_inputs: complete collision clusters at all support primes
gates.pass: A vertex cover supplies sufficient individual square tests.
gates.fail: An uncovered edge invalidates sufficiency from the cluster bounds alone.
gates.unknown: A smaller global squareclass image requires an additional global proof.

required_inputs: exact smooth nonbranch rational intersection point
gates.pass: Norm six gives a rational pair event with at most one quotient direction.
gates.fail: The degree of the whole triple intersection does not bound its individual component degrees.
gates.unknown: A rational global pair event need not lie at a supplied parameter.
